 Smith Officiates As Sri Lanka Defeat Scotland 
 November 14, 2026 
 | 0 Comments 
 Bermudian umpire Precious Smith officiated alongside India’s Gayathri Venugopalan as Sri Lanka defeated Scotland by four wickets in the 2026 ICC Women’s Emerging Nations Trophy.
 After winning the toss and electing to field, Sri Lanka restricted Scotland to 111 for eight in their allotted overs. Left-arm spinner Sugandika Kumari led the Sri Lankan bowling attack with two wickets for 15 runs from four overs. Opener Darcey Carter anchored Scotland’s innings with 62 runs off 55 deliveries.
 In reply, Sri Lanka reached 115 for six to secure the victory. Vishmi Gunaratne top-scored with 49 runs from 41 balls, while Scottish leg-spinner Abtaha Maqsood claimed three wickets for 18 runs in four overs.
